ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a food web. Spartina is drawn as a grass-like plant at the lower left. An arrow goes from Spartina toward Prokelisia, and I do not see arrows pointing into Spartina. Reasoning: In a food web, a plant at the base that provides food or energy to other organisms is a producer. Since Spartina is the plant source feeding Prokelisia, Spartina plays the role of producer.
